question: Does adding a temporal relevance component to a standard document retriever provide statistically significant improvements in answer accuracy (Exact Match/F1) for open-domain QA over versioned regulatory texts compared to strong baselines including semantic-only retrievers and existing temporal-aware methods?
description: This is the core evaluation question that needs to be answered through experimentation to validate the proposed approach's effectiveness.
rationale: All the other uncertainties feed into this fundamental question: whether our idea actually works as hypothesized when implemented and evaluated.
